name: Watcher
overview: The term 'watcher' in Scripture refers to a heavenly being who observes and executes God's sovereign decrees, as seen in Daniel's vision where a watcher and a holy one come down from heaven to enact divine judgment (Daniel 4:13, 23). These watchers serve under the authority of the Most High, demonstrating His control over earthly kingdoms by issuing decrees that shape human history (Daniel 4:17). While the Genesis and Psalms passages set the broader human context, the Daniel passages specifically reveal watchers as instruments of God's righteous governance.
